name: San Luis Obispo County, CA
findings: San Luis Obispo County has 1,004 nonprofit organizations. 407 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 303 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, San Luis Obispo County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 69 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
